name: http_get
description: HTTP GET a URL on an allow-listed host (api.github.com, repo.maven.apache.org). Use for public repository and package metadata. Returns the HTTP status and body; a large JSON array is summarised to its item count plus the first five items. Does not follow redirects. Do not use for anything on a host not listed above - it will be refused.

url.description: Absolute https URL on an allow-listed host. Example: https://api.github.com/repos/OWNER/REPO

name: read_file
description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace and return the first 5 KB. Use for source, build and configuration files such as pom.xml, package.json or README.md. Paths are relative to the workspace root; absolute paths and any path leaving the workspace are refused.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root. Example: pom.xml

name: calculator
description: Evaluate ONE arithmetic expression and return the numeric result. Supports + - * / // % ** and parentheses only - no variables, functions or comparisons. Use it for percentages and differences once you already have the numbers. Example: to find how far 812 exceeds a limit of 500 as a percentage, pass (812-500)/500*100.
